description: Source code for a REST API built with Flask, handling routes for jobs, drivers, vehicles, customers, locations, receipts, and admin login, including database interactions and file uploads.

methods.name: apiDefault
methods.description: Returns basic API info as JSON.

methods.name: returnJobs
methods.description: Handles GET and POST requests for jobs, with optional limits.

methods.name: get_job
methods.description: Handles GET, PUT, DELETE for a specific job by ID.

methods.name: returnPendingJobs
methods.description: Returns list of pending jobs, with optional limits.

methods.name: returnDoneJobs
methods.description: Returns list of delivered jobs, with optional limits.

methods.name: getParcelLocation
methods.description: Retrieves driver location info for a parcel by tracking ID.

methods.name: returnDrivers
methods.description: Handles GET and POST requests for drivers, with optional limits.

methods.name: get_driver
methods.description: Handles GET, PUT, DELETE for a specific driver by ID.

methods.name: getLocation
methods.description: Retrieves location info for a driver.

methods.name: driver_login
methods.description: Authenticates driver login, updates last connected time.

methods.name: returnVehicles
methods.description: Handles GET and POST requests for vehicles.

methods.name: get_vehicle
methods.description: Handles GET, PUT, DELETE for a specific vehicle by ID.

methods.name: returnCustomers
methods.description: Handles GET and POST requests for customers.

methods.name: get_customer
methods.description: Handles GET, PUT, DELETE for a specific customer by ID.

methods.name: returnLocations
methods.description: Handles GET and POST requests for locations.

methods.name: get_location
methods.description: Handles GET, PUT, DELETE for a specific location by ID.

methods.name: returnReceipts
methods.description: Handles GET and POST requests for receipts.

methods.name: get_receipt
methods.description: Handles GET, PUT, DELETE for a specific receipt by ID.

methods.name: get_receipt_by_driver
methods.description: Retrieves receipts for a driver on current date.

methods.name: get_full_job
methods.description: Returns detailed info for a specific job, including customer and location data.

methods.name: getAssignedJobs
methods.description: Retrieves pending jobs assigned to a driver, with full details.

methods.name: missing_resource
methods.description: Handles 404 errors for undefined routes.

methods.name: admin_login
methods.description: Handles admin login.

methods.name: getAllTable
methods.description: Fetches all records from a specified table.

methods.name: getTable
methods.description: Fetches records from a table with limit and offset.

methods.name: getRecord
methods.description: Fetches a single record by ID from a table.

methods.name: deleteRecord
methods.description: Deletes a record by ID from a table.

methods.name: createRecord
methods.description: Inserts a new record into a table.

methods.name: updateTable
methods.description: Updates a record in a table.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Handles login for users in specified table.

methods.name: getMoney
methods.description: Returns monthly revenue and receipts data.

methods.name: monthRevenue
methods.description: Calculates total revenue for a given month.

methods.name: monthReceipts
methods.description: Calculates total receipts for a given month.

methods.name: allowed_file
methods.description: Checks if filename has an allowed extension.

methods.name: upload_file
methods.description: Handles file upload for receipts.
